purpose: Carnage Circus visual concept refinement; production implementation remains paused.
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept. Edit the provided approved DOZER x IRONCLAD shield-wall concept sheet into a "CARNAGE CIRCUS" art direction for Trackstorm, a battered demolition-vehicle combat game.
PRESERVE THE APPROVED MECHANICAL DESIGN AND FUNCTION: full-height rear shield reaching from near the road to the Car roof, the same three big solid armor panels, angular Ironclad center with welded chevron reinforcement and Dozer scraping lip, chunky exposed vertical hinges, wings wrapping FORWARD along the rear quarters when mounted, and wings FULLY OPEN FLAT into a continuous straight wall when deployed. Preserve the red armored off-road Car, existing five-view layout, clear readable sketch style and off-white paper. Keep all of the bottom explanatory views and the mounted/deployed labels; ensure the center's shallow peaked top silhouette is consistent between mounted and deployed. No new mechanical systems or silhouette-extending props.
CHANGE ONLY THE ART DIRECTION / SURFACE TREATMENT / SMALL DECORATIVE DETAILS:
A sinister wrecked travelling circus converted its showground barricade into serious armored equipment. Faded oxblood crimson and dirty bone/ivory circus-tent stripes over thick welded steel; muted mustard-gold border accents, charcoal iron hinges and scraped bare steel, chipped paint and rough hand-painted imperfections. Broad bold circus graphics readable at racing distance, restrained detail rather than visual clutter. Central panel has a large stylized malevolent carnival grin and sharply angled painted eye marks integrated around the existing V reinforcement, making the armor itself suggest a dangerous funhouse face. Flat painted graphics, not a sculpted clown head. Side wings have broad alternating crimson/ivory diagonal or radiating stripes with a few battered diamond motifs; the three panels together read as a coherent showpiece when extended. A sparse row of small caged amber carnival bulbs integrated into the upper frame, visibly dirty with some unlit, subtle warm glints in daylight, not neon. A few small worn brass star-shaped bolt plates or old circus trim details attached flush to the heavy armor, no dangly cloth. Impact dents, soot, scratches and patch repairs from vehicular combat, no blood or gore. The result should feel menacing, theatrical, handmade and heavy, consistent with the red armored car's utilitarian construction.
Text: replace the top title with exactly "CARNAGE CIRCUS". Keep the useful mechanical labels. No extra slogans, logos or fine print.
Professional expressive ink/pencil industrial design concept sketch with muted color washes, same quality as source, not photorealistic and not a cartoon toy. The body shape and folding function already have user approval; do not redesign them.
